comment.narrative: The objective is not to avoid wholesale conversion but to avoid HCV trigger status loss from forest degradation by unsustainable selective logging and natural resource exploitation.

HCVs areas are validated at national level in Sao Tom and legal diploma is drafted and under review by government. In Principe initial identification of HCV was performed pending national consultation. The HCVs preidentified are for now fully protected. ST 21 HCV identified 12384Ha P 25 HCV preidentified 6837Ha
